app.title: G-Appointement web (WEB domain)

meta.description: Book visits, manage calendars, and coordinate care in English, French, and Arabic — with branding and colors from your admin dashboard.

hero.headline: Scheduling that fits your clinic and your patients
hero.subhead: Book visits, manage calendars, and keep everyone informed — with a consistent experience in every language, powered by the same published WEB translation bundle your admin tools use.

about.title: Built for healthcare teams
about.lead: From front desk to physicians, one place to coordinate care and time.
about.body: G-Appointement is designed as an appointment-first platform: reduce no-shows, clarify availability, and give patients a clear path to book or follow up. Marketing and landing copy stay accurate because strings are managed in the WEB translation domain and published to JSON — just like the rest of your stack.

features.title: What you get
features.subtitle: Solid foundations today — room to grow into full practice workflows tomorrow.
features.card1_body: Let patients request slots that match real availability, with rules you control per provider or location.
features.card2_body: Doctors, secretaries, patients, and companions each have a clear role — aligned with how your team already works.
features.card3_body: English, French, and Arabic flows share one source of truth for UI copy, so your public site and portals stay in sync.

cta.title: Ready to configure your practice?
cta.body: Sign in with an admin account to manage brand, colors, languages, and website copy from the dashboard.

contact.title: Contact & support
contact.body: Support channels and contact forms will appear here. For now, reach your team through your usual clinic channels.
